purpose: Introduce the third parallel 12345->14523 permutation family, expand the experiment-wide target union without replacing prior families, and route the first substantive physical and technical discoveries surfaced by its new states into Worldshepherd.

source_ingestion_policy.rule: Every substantive unique publication, authoritative dataset, advisory, or information item discovered during the inquiry receives a Worldshepherd use or an explicit negative-control role.
source_ingestion_policy.duplicates: Duplicate mirrors, derivative copies, repeated records, and complementary views of the same authority are provenance aliases and are not independent evidence.
source_ingestion_policy.search_noise: Search co-occurrence, article numbers, DOI suffixes, page numbers, instrument serials, postal codes, catalog identifiers, axis ticks, and similar collisions are not Glob evidence unless an independently verified physical quantity in a declared unit family is established.

sources.title: NIST Chemistry WebBook SRD 69 — Mononitrogen monosulfide (NS), constants of diatomic molecules
sources.authority: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.note: Use as an authoritative compiled molecular-spectroscopy reference. NIST defines Te in this table as minimum electronic energy in cm^-1 and lists the H 2Pi_i state with parenthesized Te = (44049). Preserve the parenthesized presentation and historical-compilation provenance rather than describing it as an unqualified exact measured line.

sources.title: Cryogenic ion trap vibrational spectroscopy of the microhydrated sulfate dianions SO4^2-(H2O)3-8
sources.authors: Harald Knorke; Huiyan Li; Jonas Warneke; Zhi-Feng Liu; Knut R. Asmis
sources.authority: Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics / Royal Society of Chemistry
sources.note: Use the D2-tagged cryogenic ion-trap infrared photodissociation methodology and broad solvent/solute vibrational coverage as a characterization reference. The generated state 27745 is only the terminal page of the 27732-27745 article range and carries zero Glob physical-evidence weight.

sources.title: Effect of Ethanol on MgO-Stabilized ZrO2 Synthesized by Anhydrous Ethanol Coprecipitation Method
sources.authors: Jun Xie; Tao Liu; Qiaoyang Sun
sources.authority: Journal of the American Ceramic Society / Wiley
sources.note: Use as a current ceramic-processing and electrochemical-characterization reference: the study reports ethanol-assisted zirconium-sulfate coprecipitation for 8 mol% MgO-stabilized ZrO2 and links agglomeration control to density and conductivity. The generated 70593 state is the article/DOI identifier e70593, not a physical measurement, so it is M1 only.

sources.title: Coefficient corrections for portable X-ray fluorescence data of the Niton XL3t No. 97390 (coefcor I-IV) developed according to the Munich procedure
sources.author: Michaela Schauer
sources.note: Use the coefficient-correction workflow as a portable-XRF calibration/comparability reference for material characterization. Here 97390 is the serial number of the Niton XL3t instrument, so the exact match to the core 14523 orbit state is an N0 control rather than physical evidence.

sources.title: Semi-empirical description of the fine structure and the radiative parameters for atomic tin. Odd levels
sources.authors: Magdalena Elantkowska; Jaroslaw Ruczkowski; Sebastian Wilman
sources.authority: Atomic Data and Nuclear Data Tables / Elsevier
sources.note: Use the multiconfiguration semi-empirical atomic-structure methodology and experimental-vs-calculated level reconciliation as a model-validation reference. A derivative full-text view surfaced a calculated 63079 cm^-1 value near an experimental 63072.6 cm^-1 level, but the exact primary publisher table row was not independently retrieved in this pass; keep 63079 gated and do not promote it to P1 yet.

permutation_update.claims_boundary: This family supplements rather than replaces 12345->31542 or 12345->13524. It is an involution with generic period 2, and all generated states retain permutation-family provenance.

exact_9675_policy.rule: 09675 and 07596 are derived five-position data and must never replace or be silently conflated with exact seed 9675.

evidence_updates.claims_boundary: NIST defines Te as minimum electronic energy in cm^-1 and displays the H 2Pi_i value as (44049). Preserve the parentheses/compilation status; this is a physical-value intersection, not proof that the permutation predicts NS spectroscopy.
27745 is a page boundary, not a measured spectroscopy quantity.
70593 is the article/DOI identifier and does not represent the material's conductivity, density, activation energy, composition, or another physical measurement.
97390 identifies a specific p-XRF instrument. The paper is useful for calibration methodology, but the serial-number equality carries zero physical Glob evidence weight.

gated_leads.note: A derivative copy of the 2020 Sn I semi-empirical paper exposes calculated 63079 cm^-1 next to experimental 63072.6 cm^-1. Because the target equality is calculated and the exact primary table row was not independently retrieved, do not promote it. If verified, it would be a theoretical/semi-empirical P1 subtype, not an experimental hit.

information_updates.finding: The 12345->14523 involution contributes 57 unique states, 39 of which already occur in the union of 12345->31542 and 12345->13524. It adds 18 new states, raising the expanded-seed three-family union from 190 to 208 unique states.
information_updates.claims_boundary: The additional 18 unique targets are additional statistical tests. Apparent hit counts must be compared against the enlarged 208-state union rather than the earlier denominator.

information_updates.finding: Under 12345->14523 the core 99073 orbit is the period-2 pair 99073 -> 97390 -> 99073.
information_updates.claims_boundary: A core-orbit state matching an instrument serial number or plot boundary is a control, not physical evidence.
